title: PowerShell: The Admin Shell for Windows

scenes.line1: Can you work without the GUI?
scenes.line2: How well do you know PowerShell?
scenes.say: Could you manage a server if you lost the Windows desktop? How well do you know PowerShell?

scenes.label: Essentials
scenes.sub: Commands use Verb-Noun, pass objects not text.
scenes.say: PowerShell commands use a verb and a noun, and they pass objects instead of plain text. That makes automation powerful.

scenes.title: Top PowerShell Moves
scenes.say: Here are some essentials. List stopped services, restart the print spooler, show top processes by CPU, or test a database port.
Need to check a port? On Linux, you use netcat. In PowerShell, Test Net Connection does the job.

scenes.question: What makes PowerShell cmdlets unique?
scenes.right: They pass objects, not just text, between commands.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: PowerShell commands pass objects, not just plain text. That's what sets them apart.
